1082:         # e.g. 1 request with 1 token when num_spec > 1 (num_spec = 3 and cudagraph_batch_size = 4 for example)
1083:         # will cause tokens are padded but requests are not

1086:             and self.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode != CUDAGraphMode.FULL
1087:         ):
1088:             # Uniform-batch case: num_reqs must be no greater than num_reqs_padded
1089:             assert num_reqs <= num_reqs_padded
